scientific.integrity: The proof uses the exact scalar MARINA recursion and an iid regenerative decomposition at full-gradient refresh epochs. The refresh-to-refresh multiplier has an explicit second moment, yielding a necessary-and-sufficient boundary; finite checks only verify algebra.
limitations: The theorem uses identical scalar client quadratics and independent half-dropout compressors.
It does not cover correlated compression, client heterogeneity, partial participation, or stochastic local gradients.
The result classifies mean-square stability, not communication-optimal tuning.
The generic source theorem is compared only as a sufficient bound, not contradicted.

title: Exact half-dropout mean-square stability frontier for scalar MARINA
